name: @interego/workspace-desktop
description: Desktop shell for the shared-workspace client. Walking skeleton: boot -> authenticate (SIWE wallet held in the OS secret store, or the relay's own browser sign-in over a loopback redirect) -> read a workspace -> render roster and stream -> post an entry onto the user's own pod. All substrate logic comes from @interego/workspace-client; this package only draws and holds keys.
author: Mark Spivey

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --target=es2020 --external:electron --outfile=dist/main.js && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --target=es2020 --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload.js && esbuild src/selftest.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --target=es2020 --external:electron --outfile=dist/selftest.js && esbuild src/renderer.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/renderer.js
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
